name: Winter's Mirage
source:
Every winter, you visit the wind phone. A disconnected phone used for one-way conversations to loved ones who have passed. 

This year, someone is waiting for you.  A stranger with a familiar camera , and a passion you've tried to forget. 

[From [url=https://sweezin.itch.io/winters-mirage]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每年冬天，你都会拜访风电话。一部已断开连接的电话，用于与已故亲人进行单向通话。

今年，有人在等你。一个陌生人，拿着熟悉的相机，还有你试图忘记的激情。

[来自[url=https://sweezin.itch.io/winters-mirage]itch.io[/url]]
